helpText:
HelpThis ScreenPartners Directory
Manage the professional digitization partners displayed in the partner directory on the website.
Header Buttons

  Add Partner — Create a new partner entry manually (opens a 4-tab form: Basic Info, Location, Services, Visibility)
  Import TSV — Bulk import partners from a tab-separated spreadsheet (paste TSV data with header row)
  View Map — Open the public partner directory map in a new tab
  Download Excel — Export all partners as a downloadable spreadsheet

Filters

  Search — Filter by partner name or city
  Status dropdown — All, Pending, Approved, or Rejected
  Type dropdown — All, Digitization, Restoration, or Transfer

Table Columns

  Date — Submission date (sortable)
  Partner — Company name (sortable)
  Type — Service type badge (sortable)
  Contact — Contact name and email
  Location — City and country (sortable)
  Status — Click the badge to cycle: Pending, Approved, Rejected (sortable)
  Active — Click to toggle Active/Inactive
  Show on Map — Click to toggle On Map/Hidden
  Actions — Edit (pencil) and Delete (trash) buttons

Partner Statuses

  Pending — New submission awaiting review
  Approved — Visible in the directory
  Rejected — Not shown to visitors

Edit Partner Form
The edit dialog has 4 tabs:

  Basic Info — Name, type, status, contact, email/phone visibility, website, description
  Location — Address, city, postal code, country, latitude/longitude
  Services — Photo/film/video format checkboxes and delivery methods
  Visibility — Active toggle, Show on Map toggle, URL slug

helpText: HelpThis ScreenTravel AgenciesMEMOPYK partners with travel agencies who collect client photos and videos for Films Souvenirs. Each agency gets a unique access code that their clients use on the upload portal to submit media. This page lets you manage two things: Uploads (view and track client submissions) and Agency Codes (create and manage partner access codes).📤 Uploads TabLists all client media submissions from the travel agency upload portal. File counts and sizes come from Nextcloud — the cloud storage platform where uploaded client files are saved.Refresh Stats — Fetch file counts and folder sizes from Nextcloud for all visible submissions.Refresh List — Reload the submission list from the database.🔍 Filters & SearchSearch bar — Search by client name or email.Agency dropdown — Filter by a specific agency code (e.g., "CAR31") or show all agencies.Date range pickers — Show only submissions within a specific date range.Submissions TableEach row shows one client submission:Date/Time — When the client submitted. Click the column header to sort.Client Name — Name and phone number.Email — Clickable email link.Agency — The agency code used, displayed as a badge. Click to sort.Share Link — Open to view the client's uploaded files in Nextcloud.Status — Status badge, e.g., Success (green).Upload Status — Load Stats to fetch folder size and file count for this submission.Actions — Resend confirmation email (envelope icon) and Delete submission (trash icon, red).🔑 Agency Codes TabManage the access codes that partner agencies give their clients. Only clients with a valid, active code can submit media through the upload portal. The total number of codes is shown at the top right.Add Agency Code — Opens a form to create a new agency with name, code, contact info, and notes.Refresh — Reload the agency list from the database.Search bar — Search by name, code, or email.Agency CardsEach agency is displayed as a card showing:Agency name — The partner's display name (e.g., "Carnet de Voyage 31").Code — The unique access code in orange (e.g., "CAR31"). This is what clients enter on the upload form.Active / Inactive — Status badge. Only active codes allow uploads.Created date — When this agency code was created.Edit — Opens a modal to update: Agency Name, Agency Code, Contact Email, Contact Phone, Notes, and Active/Inactive toggle.Delete (red) — Permanently removes this agency code.💡 Quick TipsCheck Uploads daily — sort by Date/Time descending to see newest submissions first.Click Open in the Share Link column to access a client's files in Nextcloud.Set agency codes to Inactive rather than deleting them — this preserves historical submission data.Agency codes are case-insensitive on the public upload form.How do I...Create a blog postStep-by-step guide to create a blog post, manually or with AI assistanceTranslate a postTranslate a post to another language using AI or manual toolsNeed more help? helpText:
HelpThis ScreenAI Creator
Generate blog posts using AI, powered by Brand Brain context. The AI writes in MEMOPYK's voice using your brand guidelines.

Step 1: Configure
Fill in the following fields:

  Topic - Describe what the blog post should be about (required)
  Language - French (FR) or English (EN)
  Primary Keyword - The main SEO keyword to target
  Secondary Keywords - Additional keywords (comma-separated)
  Notes - Any special instructions or angles for the AI
  Word Count - Target length (default 900 words)

Click Generate to start. Generation takes 15-30 seconds.

Step 2: Review & Save
The AI generates a complete article with:

  Title, slug, and meta description
  Formatted HTML content with headings, paragraphs, and image placeholders
  SEO metadata and suggested tags

Review the content in the editor, make any adjustments, then click Save Blog Post.

How Brand Brain Works
The AI reads all your Brand Brain entries (brand identity, tone, writing rules, audience, SEO guidelines) to generate content that matches MEMOPYK's voice. Edit Brand Brain in the AI Context tab to improve results.

Tips

  Be specific with your topic for better results
  Always review and edit AI content before publishing
  Use the Blog Editor's AI Assist for quick in-editor generation
  Start with Draft status and review before publishing

helpText:
HelpThis ScreenKeywords (107)
SEO keywords from Google Keyword Planner, organized for content planning.

Quick Filters
One-click presets for common keyword analysis tasks:

  🎯 Quick Wins — Low competition + High intent keywords in Tier 1-2. Your easiest path to conversions. Start here.
  📈 Traffic Drivers — High-volume Tier 2 keywords (1,000+ searches/mo). Build authority and brand awareness.
  💰 Money Keywords — All high-intent keywords in Tier 1-2, regardless of competition. Your full conversion universe.
  🇫🇷 France Priority — French market Tier 1-2 keywords. Focus on your home market advantage.
  ✍️ Blog Ideas — Medium intent, low-medium competition keywords. Perfect for content calendar planning.
  ✕ Clear — Reset all filters to default.

Click any preset to instantly apply its filters. The preset deactivates if you manually change any filter.

Filtering
Use the dropdowns above each column to filter:

  Search — Type to find specific keywords
  Cluster — Content category (Gift Retirement, VHS Legacy, etc.)
  Market — 🇫🇷 France or 🇺🇸 US
  Tier — Relevance to MEMOPYK service
  Searches/mo — Monthly search volume ranges
  Comp. — How hard to rank (Low/Medium/High)
  Intent — Buyer readiness

Each filter supports multi-select: check/uncheck individual options, use Select All to toggle all. Click OK to apply, Cancel to revert.

Table Columns

  Keyword — The search term. Cluster shown inline as a 🏷️ Gift Retirement tag
  Market — 🇫🇷 FR = France, 🇺🇸 US = United States
  Tier — How relevant to MEMOPYK:
    
      Tier 1 = Direct service match (best!)
      Tier 2 = High relevance
      Tier 3 = Secondary
    
  
  Searches/mo — Monthly search volume from Google
  Competition — How hard to rank:
    
      Low = Easy to rank (good!)
      Medium = Moderate effort
      High = Hard to rank
    
  
  Intent — Conversion likelihood:
    
      High = Ready to buy (best!)
      Medium = Comparing options
      Low = Just researching
    
  
  Planned Posts — Number of planned posts targeting this keyword. Click to view in the Planned Posts tab.
  Posts — Number of published posts using this keyword. Click to view in the Posts tab.


Actions

  ✏️ Edit — Modify keyword details
  🗑️ Delete — Remove (with confirmation)


Best Strategy

  Start with Quick Wins preset — these are your best ROI keywords
  Use Traffic Drivers for brand awareness content
  Create planned posts targeting these keywords first
  Track progress via the Planned Posts and Posts counts
